rulings.note: Drafted from the supervising session's entry plan of 2026-11-13 (S:/Scratch/Runs/Clifford-Amplification-Proof-20261112/ENTRY-PLAN.md), one page per source the plan lists. Only the lines the run ruled admission-ready are drafted; the candidate and context lines are in the candidate graph beside this intake, not in the ledger. Every surface is hop_eligible false pending hop review; there is no hop-bases ruling for this lane.
rulings.x_posts: X posts have never been a ledger source. Each is archived through its api.fxtwitter.com JSON mirror URL as its source_url, as a first_party capture (the author's own post); the stored copy is the mirror's JSON of the post (or, for a repost, of the reposter's timeline) as served on the retrieval day.
rulings.undated_pages: Where the entry plan says to take the page's date and the archived page states none, the surface's date is null and the lane gaps it (source_states_no_date) rather than guess one.
rulings.participant_time_fields: time_start and time_end on a participant give the dates the source states for that person's role; without them the participation row takes the surface dates.
